title_original: Check Point Extends Its Penetration Testing Capabilities
description: The Check Point Services organization is extending its penetration testing capabilities with deeper, adversary-led engagements. Customers can now choose anything from a scoped penetration test to an objective-based engagement. Each engagement shows three things: how an attacker could break into the environment, how far the attacker could get, and whether the security team would detect the attack. And because environments never stand still, the testing is proactive and continuous, not a one-time project.
